purpose: Evidence-gated CIO admission readiness index. This score is not a probability of correctness and is not an investment-performance forecast.

material_model_risk_clearance.reason: Current preregistered promotion gates remain failed or unresolved; no separate material model-risk clearance has been recorded.

dimensions.name: Data integrity / point-in-time lineage
dimensions.evidence_note: Development source routing is strong but only 294/300 company-months are machine-reproducible; six Nestle rows remain an explicit reproducibility defect and full independent P/E, P/B and dividend-yield reconstruction is incomplete. Holdout remains sealed.

dimensions.name: Reproducibility / operational reliability
dimensions.evidence_note: Automated refresh, fail-closed freshness/version guards, publication monitoring, synchronized refresh, CI controls and reproducibility artifacts are substantial, but operational history remains short.

dimensions.name: Economic rationale / specification discipline
dimensions.evidence_note: Valuation, earnings, macro and trend components have explicit rationales and governance; valuation-lens redundancy and influential reference choices remain material limitations.

dimensions.name: Historical efficacy after exposure matching, costs and taxes
dimensions.evidence_note: Robust evaluation is NOT_ELIGIBLE_FOR_PROMOTION; exposure-matched excess CAGR is small, placebo and paired block-bootstrap gates fail, and taxable after-tax implementation remains unresolved.

dimensions.name: Statistical robustness / multiple-testing control
dimensions.evidence_note: Trial registry, placebo, bootstrap, Deflated Sharpe and CSCV/PBO controls exist; PBO fails, bootstrap intervals include zero and the effective timing sample remains small.

dimensions.name: Drawdown / insurance characterization
dimensions.evidence_note: SMA10 insurance cost and episode behavior are measured, but the challenger fails its historical promotion gate and is not demonstrated alpha.

dimensions.name: Independent replication / adversarial review
dimensions.evidence_note: External review packet and immutable manifest process exist, but no qualifying independent replication is recorded.

dimensions.name: Prospective live evidence
dimensions.evidence_note: Robust evaluation records one completed monthly decision versus the preregistered minimum of 60 before promotion review.

score_change_rule: Scores may change only when repository evidence changes. Every score change must cite a new artifact, test, qualifying independent review, or completed prospective observation. Weights and thresholds must not be changed to make the current model pass.
